step_text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a 9-inch pie plate with bottom crust.
Stir the cinnamon and lemon juice into the apple pie filling
column5: then spoon it into the lined pie plate and scatter the butter over the top.

step_text: Cover with top crust and seal. Cut holes in top crust to allow venting
column5: then brush the top crust with the egg wash.

step_text: Bake for 15 minutes. Lower the oven to 350°F and bake 35 to 40 minutes more
column5: until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling.

step_text: Set the pie on a rack and let it cool for at least 2 hours before slicing.
column7: Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then form into a thin oval patty sized to fit the rye bread.

step_order: Cook the patty in a dry skillet over medium-high heat, 3–4 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet over medium-low heat, cook the onion slices in the beef drippings, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Layer the Swiss cheese, cooked patty, caramelized onions, and second slice of Swiss cheese on one slice of rye bread. Close with the second slice.
Melt the butter in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the assembled sandwich until golden-brown on both sides and the cheese is melted, about 2–3 minutes per side.
